explication: Erigon is an Ethereum execution-layer node with an optional external consensus client and an embedded consensus layer, Caplin, enabled by default. The main operator workflow is to start the node, synchronize chain data, process blocks and state, and expose node data through RPC; validators can also produce blocks. The graph includes documented networking, storage, and developer-facing services. Some subsystem links are based only on README claims or source-index references; unsampled code is not assumed to establish more specific call paths.
